title: Reject invalid or stale outcome continuations without partial results
preconditions: A retained evaluation and at least one valid outcome-list continuation exist in an isolated data root.
steps: Tamper each cursor field; replay under another evaluation, filter, page size, category lifecycle, active rule set, Ledger generation, expired snapshot, and incompatible projection; inject cancellation and malformed retained evidence.
expected: Each case returns the specified typed cursor, stale, lifecycle, compatibility, resource, or integrity error, a null result, zero returned rows, and byte-identical CLASSIFY and Ledger mutation state.
cleanup: Remove only the isolated data root.
